Madhya Pradesh CM to Hold Public Interaction in Betul

Madhya Pradesh Chief Minister Mohan Yadav is scheduled to visit Betul on June 27th to hold a 'Ratri Chaupal' (night gathering). The event aims for direct dialogue with villagers to address their concerns. The Chief Minister's visit also includes other engagements in Ujjain and Bhopal.
